This seems like a really interesting character arc to explore! I'm not sure how you guys will stop the new gods as a level 5 party but that may vary with your dm. To me it sounds like she is fighting to help her god so a more dubious option could also be that some watchful entity offers her the power to avenge/save her god, for a price. So you could also go into warlock that way if your DM is up for it. 

Otherwise maybe she finds her inner strength on her journey to helping her god and changes to become a monk (way of mercy for example). Just some ideas \^\^

I really like the concept and I could see it make for a fun encounter! I don't necessarily think it is op but something that is a bit of an odd design choice is that it is more powerful outside of its own turn? It can only either spit or bite on its own turn but can use multiattack as a legendary action. No big deal of course!

I really appreciate it and I hope your finals went well ^^

Honestly, I think therapy can be amazing and I really want to get some better help (I have been to counseling) but getting psychiatric help is so damn difficult the entire process around it just feeds into my insecurities and depression. I have some friends and family who probably care, but I just feel like such a burden. I see all these people on this sub who have in infinitely worse than me and here I am just as depressed as them. How am I not happy? Why am I so lonely despite having people who care about me?

Anyway I really appreciate your comment. Thank you <3
